---
name: Compatibility result
about: Report whether the workaround helps on your hardware
title: "[Compatibility] GPU / laptop / driver"
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

**Hardware and software**

- Laptop or desktop model
- GPU driving the affected display (Advanced display > Connected to)
- Internal panel or external monitor and refresh rate
- AMD package and adapter driver version
- Windows version/build
- Mouse model, connection and polling rate

**Result**

- Original cursor, before Apply
- After Apply and display-device/Windows restart
- After Restore, if tested
- Reboot and sleep/wake, if tested
- AC or battery, with any measured power difference

**Additional context**

Mention pointer trails, cursor replacements, MUX mode and OEM extensions if applicable. Share reviewed, relevant diagnostic details.
